cases.purpose: Independently assert path-specific Linux errno diagnostics and failure status for EPERM, ENOENT, EINVAL and EBUSY, with seccomp blocking all swapon calls.
cases.oracle: Literal C-locale Linux strerror messages and status 1; independent libc control checks each seccomp errno before candidate execution.
cases.comparison: One diagnostic line ending in swapon: PATH: MESSAGE, empty stdout, status 1; Bash location prefix permitted.
